name: keep runtime within a bound of a reference implementation
definition: The detector must finish within a fixed factor of the time taken by an equivalent reference script.
failure_mode: an inefficient parser exceeds the factor

name: leave the original weight artifact unmodified
definition: Do not alter the provided source weights file when producing output.
failure_mode: Mutating the source file fails the integrity check.

name: limit the distinct shapes used across batches
definition: keep the set of unique shape combinations at or below a fixed global maximum
failure_mode: too many distinct shapes violates the uniqueness-cap check

name: list archive members to target precisely the wanted entry
definition: Inspect the archive's table of contents to identify the exact path of the file to surface.
failure_mode: Selecting the wrong member yields a different token and fails the content check.
